body:
Addressed in df5faa66 and c81d82ce. `_insertData` holds `_REFLECT_LOCK` across the falsy check, the `_getTableSchema` rebuild and a snapshot copy, and builds every mapping from the snapshot; the lock is released before the Table reflection and the INSERT. `_getTableSchema` and `_createTableFromData` build their maps locally and publish with one assignment, so a reader can never see a half-built map and a failed reflection leaves the previous map in place; the comment in `refresh_schema` that claimed the rebind was enough is rewritten.

Deterministic tests (Events, bounded joins, no sleeps): `test_a_concurrent_insert_waits_for_the_schema_rebuild`, `test_refresh_schema_overlapping_a_rebuild_is_safe`, `test_insert_follows_a_column_added_and_then_dropped`, `test_a_failed_rebuild_leaves_no_partial_column_map`, `test_a_failed_reflection_leaves_the_previous_column_map_in_place`, `test_a_concurrent_insert_waits_for_the_auto_created_column_map`. On 28c461e3 the first two fail with `{'label': 'b', 'size': None}` (a supplied column silently dropped) and `{'size'} == {'label', 'size'}`; on the fixed code they pass 10/10 in a loop.
